rows.text: Owned Ghidra checkpoints save the initial Program and every acknowledged metadata edit. Restores use a verified private copy without rerunning auto-analysis, and preserve the original timeout and seed identity. Original executable bytes are never written.
After retirement, reopen the target to resolve its saved generation; an old profile cannot silently restart from changed state. Publisher locks are not reclaimed automatically after owner crashes.
Default-space addresses use lowercase 0x-prefixed hexadecimal; other address spaces use <percent-encoded-space>:0x<hex>.
The direct address list projects exact Ghidra references to one address but does not expose their kinds; procedure_references and analyze_function preserve available kind metadata.
Synthetic Ghidra entry-point references without actionable memory sources are omitted.
macOS sessions require a matching executable Ghidra native decompiler; REA+ checks for it but does not build native components or change Gatekeeper quarantine state.

limitations: Read native-context limitations for the complete source caveats; the retained parent remains authoritative.
unknowns: Pages exhaust recorded observations, not complete native discovery. Interpretation beyond these facts requires the source caveats.
